chunks.text: HerTechTable is a 12-week program for women who want to build their own tech business or freelance practice — not get hired by someone else. You develop your service offering, learn to use AI tools in your work, and pitch to your first paying client at ClientZero. The program is currently in development but the waitlist is open. Tagline: Can't find a seat? Build your own table. Philosophy: if you can't find a seat at the tech table, build the table yourself. Self-employment is not a backup plan — it is a legitimate, powerful path into the tech economy.

HerTechTable is designed for women who want to create their own work, not get hired by someone else. They have a skill, idea, or service they want to build a business around. They are motivated by independence, flexibility, and ownership. They want to use AI and tech tools to build, deliver, and market their services. They are ready to commit to developing a real, sellable offering in 12 weeks. They want to pitch to their first paying client at ClientZero.

HerTechTable is NOT designed for women who want to get hired at a tech company (that is HerTechReady), have no idea what service or skill they want to offer (some starting clarity helps), or are looking for a business grant or investor funding at this stage.

HerTechTable confirmed components: AI studio — hands-on exploration of AI tools a service business owner can actually use. Incubator — structured support for developing a viable service offering and testing with real potential clients. Pitch support — coaching on how to articulate value, pitch services, and position in the market. Build your services — portfolio and service package development including case studies, service descriptions, pricing, and proposals.

ClientZero is the quarterly in-person event that closes each HerTechTable cohort. Zero is not nothing — zero is the starting line. ClientZero is where her business begins. Graduates pitch their services to a curated audience of potential clients, investors, and mentors. Primary goal: leave with your first paying client. Format: live pitch presentations, client matchmaking, and networking. Quarterly, 4 per year.

The core difference between HerTechReady and HerTechTable: HerTechReady is for women who want to get hired in tech. HerTechTable is for women who want to build their own thing in tech. Same 12-week format, same ecosystem — completely different destinations. HerTechTable is currently in development. If asked when it launches: say 'HerTechTable is in development right now — I don't have a confirmed launch date yet. The best way to stay informed is to join the waitlist.'
